svg.text: The web-shell chain — from temporary to persistent
Different arrival channels changed what access.log could reveal. All timestamps are UTC.
WHY LOG-ONLY ANALYSIS MISSES THE FULL CHAIN
c99 commands reside in POST bodies.
c99 arrived without an upload request.
Last shell request: 03 Sep 07:31:54. Reverse connection attempt is consistent with the stager;
a successful outbound session was not captured. Disk metadata + memory close the HTTP gaps.
